name: GPEx mK Flagship and GPMD Carve-Out Doctrine
core_note: Use mKs-only for flagship and likely all GPMDs.
carve_out_rule: This doctrine does not change current K-KUT public buyer flow.
k_kut_buyer_flow_rule: mKs remain banned from current public K-KUT buyer flow unless explicitly re-approved later.
why: Flagship and GPMD systems may need smaller, modular, highly personal audio objects.
K-KUT public HUG buyer flow currently sells approved K-KUT / KK options, not mKs.
Enterprise doctrine must distinguish future flagship/GPMD architecture from current buyer-facing K-KUT safety rules.
allowed_future_use: future approved product architecture after separate audit
not_allowed_now: mKs in public HUG sales language
mKs in buyer emails or fulfillment proof
mKs in public pages without explicit re-approval
approval_gate: Define the specific flagship or GPMD product.
Define how mKs function inside that product.
Prove no leakage into current K-KUT public buyer flow.
locked_summary: mKs may be right for flagship and GPMD systems. They remain out of current K-KUT buyer flow.
